::: cv-cabecera
::: cv-cabecera__texto
**Postdoctoral Researcher** at the Doñana Biological Station (EBD-CSIC), Seville, Spain. PhD in Biology (Museum and Institute of Zoology, Warsaw). I study species interactions in ant, microbiome and mycobiome communities.
:::

::: cv-linea
::: cv-hito
[Jan 2025 – present]{.cv-fecha}

[Postdoctoral Researcher]{.cv-puesto}

[Doñana Biological Station (EBD-CSIC), Department of Conservation Biology and Global Change · Seville, Spain]{.cv-lugar}
:::

::: cv-hito
[May 2024 – Jun 2024]{.cv-fecha}

[Specialist in ant species identification]{.cv-puesto}

[Doñana Biological Station (EBD-CSIC), Department of Conservation Biology and Global Change · Seville, Spain]{.cv-lugar}

Identification of ant species from pitfall-trap samples from Spain, France, Belgium and the Netherlands, for ecological research and biodiversity assessments.

## Education

::: cv-linea
::: cv-hito
[Oct 2019 – Sep 2024]{.cv-fecha}

[PhD in Biology]{.cv-puesto}

[Museum and Institute of Zoology, Polish Academy of Sciences · Warsaw, Poland]{.cv-lugar}

How do reintroductions of parasites work? A multi-level comparison of source and reintroduced populations of *Phengaris teleius*: population genetics, adult morphology, and the behavioural, chemical and acoustic adaptations of the caterpillars to their *Myrmica* host ants.
:::

::: cv-hito
[Oct 2017 – Jul 2018]{.cv-fecha}

[MSc in Biodiversity and Conservation Biology]{.cv-puesto}

[Universidad Pablo de Olavide · Seville, Spain]{.cv-lugar}

Thesis graded 9.8/10, with honours. The effect of temperature on ant assemblages from different habitats, through taxonomic and functional diversity, and a new index for the direct effect of temperature on interspecific competition.
:::

::: cv-hito
[Sep 2012 – Sep 2016]{.cv-fecha}

[BSc in Biology]{.cv-puesto}

[Universitat de València · Valencia, Spain]{.cv-lugar}

Thesis graded 9.5/10. Ant communities of the Sierra de Javalambre: species distribution along an altitudinal gradient, and the patching effect of *Juniperus sabina* on ant activity and nesting.
:::
:::

## Conference talks and posters

- [Talk]{.cv-tipo} **Reintroduction provides insight into multimodal mimicry evolution in an ant social parasite.** *XIX Congress of the Spanish Society of Ethology and Evolutionary Ecology*, Seville, Spain (2025).

- [Poster]{.cv-tipo .cv-tipo--poster} **ANT HUNTERS: A citizen science initiative for ant biodiversity research.** *XIX Congress of the Spanish Society of Ethology and Evolutionary Ecology*, Seville, Spain (2025).
- [Poster]{.cv-tipo .cv-tipo--poster} **ANT HUNTERS: La ciudadanía a la caza de la biodiversidad de hormigas.** *XIX International Congress of Myrmecology, Taxomara 2025*, Girona, Spain (2025).

- [Talk]{.cv-tipo} **Changes in morphology and genetic structure in two populations of *Phengaris* (= *Maculinea*) *teleius* 30 years after separation.** *Butterfly Conservation Symposium 2023*, Wyboston, England (2023).

- [Talk]{.cv-tipo} **Aspectos ecológicos sobre la mirmecocenosis de solana de la Sierra de Javalambre (Teruel).** *XI Iberian Congress of Myrmecology, Taxomara 2016*, Murcia, Spain (2016).
